source_snapshot.scope_note: Static source audit after independent generation/fuzz/shrink, fuzz observers and oracle generation forwarding were added in all four languages. Authors reported source stable pending compiler/runtime findings; hashes identify audited bytes. Not a build, execution or installed-package receipt. Subsequent review fixes invalidate affected hashes and require refresh. A later binary-v1 scoped review adds/refreshes only the files listed in scoped_reviews; the original timestamp/head and unrelated feature mappings/hashes are preserved. Runtime qualification is not inferred.

scoped_reviews.scope: binary-v1 structural codecs, explicit run configuration, binary limits, exports and candidate markers
scoped_reviews.qualification_note: Static implementation mapping only. Qualification fields and receipt links remain unchanged; parent-owned runtime/cross-language receipts are separate. All unrelated feature cells and source hashes were preserved.

status_definitions.implemented: Named scoped behavior has a native implementation in reviewed source; not full gap closure.
status_definitions.partial: Native APIs implement part of named Rust behavior; remaining states exact omissions.
status_definitions.missing: No independent native engine API in reviewed export surfaces; application workarounds and ABI adapters do not close this gap.
status_definitions.qualification-pending: No runtime qualification performed or imported as current evidence by this source audit.

state_model_note: Implementation audit states are separate from plan milestone/qualification/release states. No qualified or released assertions are made.

features.capability: Application-owned state/input/output and ordered state/transition checks
features.remaining: Scoped core callbacks exist. Requalify full Rust callback ordering/errors, alias isolation and non-boolean disposition reasons; no new runtime qualification inferred. Metadata is codec-owned in Go/Swift and optional on basic Python/TS models.

features.capability: Caller-owned append-only check/encoding buffers
features.remaining: Native collectors allocate returned lists/tuples/slices/arrays; no equivalent public append sink, bounded EncodeBuffer or reusable observation buffer API. Equivalent allocation/storage guarantee is required; Rust borrowing syntax is not.

features.capability: Finite exact-equality BFS and structural limits
features.remaining: Implemented only for bfs-v1 bounds (states, transitions, depth). SearchTermination is a richer Rust enum; do not equate five native string outcomes with cancellation/deadline/estimated-byte outcomes. Shared collision, lazy-error and incomplete-search cases require retained receipts.

features.capability: Cooperative controls and retained-state estimates across search entrypoints
features.remaining: Cooperative cancellation/deadline and aggregate shrink replay-transition limits are implemented for new fuzz/shrink operations. They are not wired into existing BFS or recording/replay APIs. Native retained-state estimates/SearchLimits, byte-limit report outcomes and observed BFS remain missing. Controls cannot preempt one callback/iterator pull or cap hidden allocations.

features.capability: Model codecs, bounded recording and exact replay
features.remaining: Scoped portable recording/exact replay remains implemented. New binary-v1 AuditTrace codecs preserve explicitly supplied RunConfig alongside the portable trace, but existing recorders do not directly accept/stamp Rust RunConfig or enforce all binary artifact quotas during capture/reserve a bounded model-error footer. These recorder/resource behaviors, reusable bounded sinks, rich replay observations and causal evidence remain open. Restored-state/input canonical validation and build-override boundaries need continued conformance.

features.capability: Phase-aware replay observations, bounded differences and actual-error context
features.remaining: Native replay reports identify first divergence/step/field, but do not expose Rust replay observation callbacks, bounded multi-field differences or typed actual transition context on replay callback errors.

features.capability: Independent history, observed transitions, checks and ORC1 checkpoints
features.remaining: All four now compose explicit independent history, checks, enumeration/codecs and generation/enabled/simplification behavior; Go uses WithOracleGenerate and Swift Generate.withOracle as typed additive adapters. Python/TypeScript preserve incremental checker iteration. Native estimated_state_bytes forwarding and equivalent caller-owned append/encode buffers remain missing. Optional hook availability, history equality and error-preserved completed transitions require qualification; Swift throwing array callbacks cannot recover internally emitted partial checks.

features.capability: Independent reference advancement and state/effect/disposition projection comparison
features.remaining: Candidate paired-v1 APIs exist in all four and can feed native generation/fuzz/shrink through oracle adapters. Experimental profile status remains; exact reference independence, ordered effects, disposition reason, history-only differences and actual failure replay still need retained runtime/installed-consumer evidence.

features.capability: SplitMix64 vectors and unbiased bounded-choice primitive
features.remaining: rng-splitmix64-v1 primitive exists independently; this is not a generator/fuzz implementation. Exact max-width arithmetic, zero-bound and rejection consumption remain qualification obligations.

features.capability: Explicit generation, automatic finite-domain sampling and bounded membership
features.remaining: Native explicit generation, finite reservoir sampling, bounded causal membership and default empty simplifiers are implemented for candidate search-v1. Sampling commits RNG only after complete successful domain scan; cap+1 distinguishes overflow. Exhaustion is EXHAUSTED/Python, present bool/Go, NO_INPUT/TypeScript, outer Optional/Swift; null-like supported inputs must remain distinguishable. Named public helper shapes differ (Python/Go expose behavior through Auto). Independent hostile-domain and installed-consumer qualification remains pending.

features.capability: Seeded fuzz execution and structured bounded reports
features.remaining: Independent seeded case loops, previous-passing-case deletion/replacement mutation, input-enabled checks, initial/successor/transition properties, witnesses and structured budgets/reports are implemented. Candidate search-v1 fixes random consumption and boundary semantics. No guided corpus/campaign implementation or exhaustive-search claim follows; independent qualification, installed packages, platforms and resource measurements remain pending.

features.capability: Fuzz initial/transition/check-error observations with owned input history
features.remaining: Fuzz observer hooks now expose defensive snapshots, full executed prefix including failing turn, ordered state/transition batches and explicit check-error completeness. Native observer errors are explicit engine errors unlike Rust unit-returning callbacks. Python/TypeScript incremental iterators and Go returned partial checks can expose valid failed-batch prefixes; Swift list-returning throw batches are empty/incomplete, and complete prior state checks remain visible. No needs_history optimization or observed BFS API exists; runtime logging/ring/debug observer families remain separate missing features.

features.capability: Failure/phase-preserving sequence and input shrinking
features.remaining: Independent original validation, ordered chunk deletion/input alternatives, causal membership, first-target property ID+phase preservation, accepted-sequence cycle checks, operation history, cancellation/deadline and aggregate replay budgets are implemented. Runtime qualification remains pending. Attempt caps bound replays, not arbitrary iterator/equality work: infinite already-seen alternatives may consume no attempts; cooperative controls cannot preempt a nonreturning callback. Reports establish no global minimality.

features.capability: Feedback, novelty, retained corpus and guided fuzz
features.remaining: No independent feedback/corpus/guided search API. An application state hash alone is not novelty accounting or bounded corpus semantics.

features.capability: Reproducible ordinary/guided jobs, scheduling, delivery and acknowledgement
features.remaining: No independent campaign APIs. src/campaign/lifecycle.rs is private implementation, not an exported lifecycle module; lifecycle behavior remains required by campaign reports/delivery and the plan explicitly requires a native fixture.

features.capability: Check completed transitions once with periodic/disabled checks
features.remaining: Periodic state and optional transition checks exist. Rust checked-initial/checked-turn token APIs carrying exact check counts and full-checking provenance have no public equivalent; no evidence-safe handoff into native recorder/debugger yet.

features.capability: Configurable observer events, payload formatting, levels and snapshot policy
features.remaining: checkObserved output can be logged by applications but no independent equivalent event/observer/formatting or snapshot policy API exists.

features.capability: Bounded production recording, checkpoints, retained suffix and eviction provenance
features.remaining: Native record() is a bounded finite run, not a production ring recorder. No native checkpoint/absolute-sequence/evicted-prefix/suffix-replay APIs. ABI recorder alternatives do not close this gap.

features.capability: Two-model routing and queue-bearing composite model
features.remaining: Paired conformance is an oracle/reference comparison, not composition::Pair routing. No independent composition wrapper or modeled delivery actions exist.

features.capability: Multi-machine scheduling and FIFO/unordered queues
features.remaining: No independent network model/queue policy/local-deliver-drop-duplicate API. User-constructed models are possible but not a library equivalent.

features.capability: Legacy event/history monitor and indexed epoch/generation retention
features.remaining: OracleState can store application history but does not implement lifecycle obligations, stale-generation rejection, retirement fences or historical lifecycle codecs.

features.capability: Required properties, phases, coverage, provenance, assessment and aggregation
features.remaining: Native Check/Violation/SearchReport do not establish required observations, applicability, input-family/goal coverage or assurance assessments. String property IDs are a foundation only.

features.capability: Production-shaped controller, named mutations, host and coverage fixtures
features.remaining: Native counter/queue examples do not port the Rust controller, mutation catalog, requirement/coverage manifest, host and evidence regression suite.

features.capability: Portable JSON observation envelope and strict parsing
rust_api: src/trace.rs:63 Trace (underlying engine trace; JSON is a portable adapter envelope, not Trace::write_to binary format)
features.remaining: Current portable JSON profile implemented. Must retain historical parsing/limits/canonical checkpoint behavior when binary formats are added. No 25-pair binary interoperability claim follows.

features.capability: Structural Rust binary trace v1 read/write and lossless run-configuration representation
features.remaining: Scoped to independent structural binary-v1 codecs and explicit configuration-preserving conversions. All nine independent byte/item/step limits and full-trace writer preflight have source implementations; no runtime, adversarial allocation/I/O, installed-package or cross-language interoperability qualification is imported. Direct recording still uses the portable shape: native recorder RunConfig/provenance stamping, encoded-artifact admission and reserved bounded model-error footer capture policy remain open. Step check phases are unknown_legacy; binary v2/causal evidence, canonical value codecs, rich replay observations and durable publication are separate gaps. A structurally decoded model_error prefix does not establish terminal-error reproduction. Rust TraceError::AllocationFailed is not a uniform native error variant: Python translates MemoryError, while the reviewed Go/Swift/TypeScript surfaces do not expose that same recoverable variant. Swift stream callback errors propagate as their original host errors rather than a BinaryTraceError I/O case. Full error-family parity is therefore not claimed.

features.capability: Bounded canonical scalar/container codecs
features.remaining: Native model codecs are user callbacks over bytes. No library equivalent canonical Rust value codec/decoder family or container implementations; JSON readers are not this value encoding.

features.capability: Binary v2 phase-aware evidence, provenance and causal output origins
features.remaining: Both portable TraceStep and new binary-v1 AuditTrace retain flat step checks and lack v2 phase/causal metadata. Initial phase is known; successor/transition phases in decoded v1 evidence are unknown_legacy and cannot be inferred from IDs/order. Missing causal origins/provenance cannot be reconstructed from v1 JSON or binary traces; explicit verified replay upgrade or v2 evidence remains required.

features.capability: Simulation sessions, exact historical viewers, verified branches and minimization
features.remaining: Replay report is not a debugger session/viewer/fork. Native optional debugger packages and verified branch/minimization APIs do not exist.

features.capability: Structural bounded inspection, differences, watches and diagnostic sinks
features.remaining: Native printing/debug representations do not provide schema/path/revision/authority/boundedness equivalents. Must be optional packages with redaction separate from exact evidence.

features.capability: Bounded stdio protocol and cooperative live pause/delivery authority
features.remaining: Corpus newline-JSON protocol is a conformance runner, not debugger protocol compatibility or cooperative pause control.

features.capability: Effect timing, metrics, passive dashboard and evidence correlation
features.remaining: No independent bounded effect telemetry/metric catalog/report implementation. Host-specific async observation may differ, but loss/unknown time/provenance must remain visible.

features.capability: Bounded domains, lazy check details and typed modeling metadata
features.remaining: Native check constructors and ordinary input arrays do not provide bounded Domain descriptors/product generation or lazy failure-detail helpers. Rust check! syntax needs an idiomatic lazy-details equivalent, not a literal macro port.

features.capability: Model/codec/domain/inspection adapters and validation diagnostics
features.remaining: Existing typed Model builders/protocols let applications handwrite adapters; no equivalent validated model/domain/codec/inspection generation or expansion provenance. Rust procedural syntax/compiler diagnostics are Rust-specific mechanisms, while generated behavior, boundedness and invalid-definition detection remain required outcomes.

features.capability: Native corpus runner, table model and portable fixture entrypoints
rust_api: src/conformance.rs:7 Projection (paired engine API, distinct from corpus executables)
features.remaining: Independent conformance runners exist for current portable profiles and candidate pairing; broad Rust CLI/demo/example parity is not established. Packaging, installed-consumer commands and expanded native fixtures remain work.

features.capability: Finite exact-versus-projected reachability experiment and known unsound witness
features.remaining: No independent research harness equivalent. Experimental status and known unsound projection fixture must be preserved; no general POR/liveness promise is required.

features.capability: Runnable request-model teaching example and native CLI behavior
features.remaining: Counter/corpus programs are present, but not the Rust RequestModel teaching surface or the broad Rust CLI command set. Equivalent runnable teaching scenarios and user-facing tooling behavior are required; literal Rust binary syntax and private CLI helpers are not.

residuals: Feature/API grouping is reviewed; every lexical declaration has not yet received individual semantic disposition.
Associated types and representative enum variants are accounted in audit; exhaustive variant/case/trait-implementation parity remains pending.
Rust cfg and target-specific FFI exports require target expansion audit. Macro-generated application exports depend on invocation and are not enumerated.
Exact language deployment/platform/runtime floors and installed-consumer performance qualification remain open.

Native bounded generation/fuzz/shrink and fuzz observations are implemented in this snapshot; BFS/replay cooperative controls, state-byte estimates, append-buffer partial-check equivalence and all later milestone groups remain open.

Native binary-v1 structural read/write, lossless RunConfig and all nine limit families have source implementations; direct binary-budgeted recording/provenance/footer capture, binary v2 causal evidence, canonical value codecs, durable publication and installed native/Rust interoperability qualification remain open. N11 is not closed.
General liveness, general partial-order reduction, a TUI and LLDB/GDB integration are outside the pinned Rust baseline; no extra native gap is invented for them.
